title: Answer: brains whose fields are complex and act on neurons

statements.text: What is conscious is a field complex enough to encode complex computations and able to act on a motor system, which so far means the fields inside brains. Toasters and conventional computers are not conscious, a machine computing through fields could be, and whether animal fields are causally active is open.

sources.quote: Neither of these conditions is satisfied by the EM fields of a toaster or any other EM field, other than those inside brains.
